page_title: HEI 4-0 AUG | Heidenheim v Augsburg 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is the recipient.
90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+3' The shot by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Nediljko Labrovic.
90+2' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nediljko Labrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Nediljko Labrovic.
87' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kevin Muller comes off the line to clear the ball away.
84' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
83' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) replacing Adrian Beck.
81' Leo Scienza goes off the pitch and Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) comes on.
80' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
80' The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
79' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
76' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
74' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) replaces Arne Maier.
73' 4 - 0 Goal - 4:0! Sirlord Conteh laid the ball off to Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
71' A cooling break is underway.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) will replace Marvin Pieringer.
70' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Paul Wanner and he is replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
69' Caution goes to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
69' 3 - 0 Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) has a golden opportunity after receiving a fantastic pass. He keeps his cool and lashes the ball in off the right post.
67' The corner is swung in and Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
67' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
66' The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.

66' What a miss! Steve Mounie (Augsburg) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
63' Here is a change. Tim Breithaupt is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Mert Komur (Augsburg).
63' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
62' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' The game is interrupted now, Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Arne Maier (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
59' Substitution. Phillip Tietz did his best and is replaced by Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
58' The ball is cleared after Samuel Essende (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
56' Paul Wanner nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
56' Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
55' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
53' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
52' That's a well-taken pass by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
51' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
48' Nediljko Labrovic leaps to intercept the corner kick from Paul Wanner (Heidenheim).
48' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Fredrik Jensen comes off for Ruben Vargas (Augsburg).
46' Jess Thorup makes a half-time substitution. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) comes on in place of Mads Pedersen.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Arne Maier (Augsburg).
45+4' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nediljko Labrovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+4' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
45+3' Heidenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+2' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
43' A player from Heidenheim brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
42' The resulting corner from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is cleared.
41' Lennard Maloney is substituted due to injury. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
41' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
40' A player from Augsburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Heidenheim will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
39' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
36' None of the Augsburg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
33' A player from Heidenheim pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
30' 2 - 0 Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
29' Heidenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
26' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Augsburg.

23' What a chance that is! Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
23' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
19' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
18' One of the Augsburg players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
16' A long pass finds Arne Maier (Augsburg) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
16' Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
15' 40:60 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
11' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Nediljko Labrovic into right side of the goal.
9' The Heidenheim players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
9' There's a break in play and referee Martin Petersen must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Heidenheim using VAR. This could be interesting!
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
5' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends a long ball in, but Nediljko Labrovic comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' OFF THE BAR! Arne Maier (Augsburg) produces a thunderbolt of a strike from distance, but his effort rattles the crossbar!
2' One of the Heidenheim players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Augsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen was nominated as the referee for this game.
